runs.worker_wall_scope: Parent monitored_execute elapsed_seconds: Python monotonic interval around executor thread, resource sampling and cleanup; not worker CPU or pure Julia time.
runs.process_utc_scope: Post-Popen start sample to after wait/stdio closing; distinct origin from monitor and worker time_ns.
runs.duration_gap_scope: Difference of independently scoped durations; not an exact exclusive startup/GC/IO/compilation attribution.
runs.self_time_scope: Only disjoint self times are added. Container self remains unclassified, not reassigned to management or a named scientific kernel.

hierarchy.scope: Closed spans only. Missing active spans are not inferred as zero or reconstructed from file times.

interpretation: At most two maps; not SCF convergence.
No extrapolation to cancelled K6 costs.
First map versus subsequent map is not a compiled versus fully warmed distinction.
B0 numerical-contract agreement does not imply identical iteration or operator counts; cold wall differences do not isolate timer overhead.
Raw callback/checkpoint k_index may retain the last solved k (8/64) outside k_total. Only k_total ancestry establishes per-k timing scope; labels are preserved unchanged.
No isolated GC, native-library or physical-disk-flush measurement.
